simple.meaning: שָׁבַת (shâbath) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to repose , i.e. desist from exertion ; used in many implied relations (causative, figurative or specific).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 71 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 14 more, beginning at Genesis 2:2. Its contexts include land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁבַת (H7673).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שָׁבַת (shâbath) / H7673 is traced through Genesis 2:2, Genesis 2:3, Genesis 8:22, Exodus 5:5 as a generated source-based concept entry.
